tag_dictionary.notes: IrisFStop (0x8000), FocusPositionFromImagePlane f16 (0x8001), LensZoom35mm/Actual (0x8007/08), IrisTStop (0x800A); relayed by libInfraLensCommunicator.so (0B ELF diff)
NDFilter (0x8103 FX6-only), SensorSize (0x8104/05), FrameRate (0x8106), ShutterAngle (0x8108 = i32 / 60.0 deg), ShutterSpeed (0x8109), ISO (0x810B), ASC_CDL (0x8117), ColorMatrix (0x8118)

0xE400 ImagerPos [nm], 0xE405 SensorSizePixels, 0xE406/07 PixelPitch [nm], 0xE40B..0E FirstFrameTimestamp/Exposure/FrameReadoutTime, 0xE40F IBISTimeOffset (16B entries), 0xE450 IBISRollAngle (10B entries); FX3 has 5-axis IBIS while FX6 lacks IBIS
0xE416 LensOSSTimeOffset (t, x, y, z) — sole optical stabilization source on FX6; fused with IBIS on FX3
0xE43A orientation (XYZ=0x420 -> Gyroflow swap X/Y & negate Z), 0xE43B GyroData (pitch, roll, yaw), 0xE43D/E zero-rate offset
Large vendor extension payloads safely skipped/preserved by telemetry-parser
